gloss: to be at a loss; to be troubled; to hold one's head in one's hands

definitions.gloss: to be at a loss; to be troubled; to be deeply worried
definitions.explanation: To be so worried, troubled, or perplexed by a difficult situation that one holds one's head in distress. Expresses a state of being unable to find a solution or way forward.

examples.japanese: {頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}えてしまった。
examples.english: I was at a complete loss.

examples.japanese: {借金|しゃっきん}の{返済|へんさい}に{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}えている。
examples.english: I'm troubled about paying back my debts.

examples.japanese: {人手不足|ひとでぶそく}で{会社|かいしゃ}は{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}えている。
examples.english: The company is troubled by a shortage of workers.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}の{進路|しんろ}について{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}えている。
examples.english: I'm worrying about my son's future path.

examples.japanese: {予算|よさん}が{足|た}りなくて、{担当者|たんとうしゃ}は{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}えている。
examples.english: The person in charge is at a loss because the budget isn't enough.

notes:
IDIOM MEANING:
Literally "to hold one's head (in one's hands)." This describes the physical gesture of distress when overwhelmed by problems, and idiomatically means to be deeply troubled or at a loss.

GRAMMAR:
〜に{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}える - to be troubled by/about ~
〜で{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}える - to be troubled because of ~

CONJUGATION:
・{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}える (present/future)
・{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}えている (progressive - currently troubled)
・{頭|あたま}を{抱|かか}えた (past)

COMMON CAUSES:
・{問題|もんだい} - problems
・{借金|しゃっきん} - debt
・{人間関係|にんげんかんけい} - relationships
・{仕事|しごと} - work
・{子供|こども}のこと - matters concerning children

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
・{悩|なや}む - to worry, to be troubled
・{困|こま}り{果|は}てる - to be at wit's end
・{途方|とほう}に{暮|く}れる - to be at a loss
・{頭|あたま}を{悩|なや}ます - to rack one's brains
・{手|て}を{焼|や}く - to have trouble with

REGISTER:
Neutral. Common in everyday conversation and news reporting.
